Expression of Interest: Motion Designer / rotoscoping
 Cavalry is building a talent pool of experienced Motion Designers and rotoscoping for an upcoming client requirement.
 While there isn’t an immediate role available, our client regularly has projects requiring a quick turnaround , so we’re looking to connect with talented creatives who can be ready to jump in when opportunities arise.
 We're keen to hear from designers with experience in:

• Graphic design and motion graphics

• Adobe After Effects

• Creating engaging visual and animated content

• Working to tight deadlines and quick turnarounds

• Adobe Creative Suite

 If you're a strong designer with After Effects experience and are open to hearing about future freelance opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.
